# discord_pinned_messages (Data Source)

Lists the pinned messages of a channel, most recently pinned first. The bot needs the View Channel permission; without Read Message History, Discord returns no pins.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_pinned_messages" "announcements" {
  channel_id = var.channel_id
}

output "pinned_message_ids" {
  value = data.discord_pinned_messages.announcements.messages[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel or thread.

### Read-Only

- `messages` (Attributes List) Pinned messages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messages))

<a id="nestedatt--messages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `messages`

Read-Only:

- `author_id` (String) ID of the author.
- `author_username` (String) Username of the author.
- `content` (String) Text content. Empty unless the bot has the Message Content privileged intent or wrote the message.
- `edited_timestamp` (String) When the message was last edited, or null.
- `flags` (Number) [Message flags](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/message#message-object-message-flags) bitfield.
- `id` (String) Message ID.
- `pinned` (Boolean) Whether the message is pinned.
- `pinned_at` (String) When the message was pinned.
- `timestamp` (String) When the message was sent.
- `type` (Number) [Message type](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/message#message-object-message-types), `0` for a default message.
- `webhook_id` (String) ID of the webhook that sent the message, if any.
